description: This file contains definitions for the BytezChatConfig class, custom stream wrapper, and related utilities for interfacing with Bytez's API within a larger chat-based AI system. It handles configuration, request/response transformation, streaming responses, and error handling.

classes.name: BytezChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Bytez's API interface, extending BaseConfig to set parameters and handle request/response transformation.

classes.name: BytezCustomStreamWrapper
classes.description: Custom stream wrapper class to process streamed API responses, converting chunks into structured data while handling exceptions.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported OpenAI parameters according to the internal parameter map.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Adapts OpenAI parameters into Bytez-specific parameters based on configuration, with options to drop or raise errors on unsupported params.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and updates headers, ensuring API key presence and correct message format before request.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the API endpoint URL based on base URL, model, and optional parameters.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms chat messages and parameters into the request payload for Bytez API.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes raw HTTP response from Bytez API, extracting content, handling errors, and updating model response metadata.

methods.name: "BytezCustomStreamWrapper" get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[Union[HTTPHandler, AsyncHTTPHandler]] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )
methods.description: Performs a synchronous API request with streaming response, returning a custom stream wrapper.

methods.name: "BytezCustomStreamWrapper" get_async_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[Union[HTTPHandler, AsyncHTTPHandler]] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous API request with streaming response, returning a custom stream wrapper.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an exception instance corresponding to an error response.

methods.name: chunk_creator(self, chunk: Any)
methods.description: Creates and processes chunks of streamed data into consistent response objects, handling exceptions.
